Tenable Report StudioVulnerability & compliance reporting

Drop a Tenable export here

CSV or Excel from Security Center (Analysis > Vulnerabilities > Vulnerability Detail List > Export, or a CSV report). Vulnerability and compliance rows can be in one file or several. Everything runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded anywhere.

1. ExportVulnerability Detail List, severities Critical to Low. For compliance include Info so passed checks are counted.
2. LoadDrop any number of files, old and new. The newest export is "now", older ones become history for the trend. Duplicates across repositories are removed.
3. ReviewDashboard, remediation actions, vulnerabilities with the Tenable solution and evidence, compliance, host by host. Pick a scope (environment, site, system) at the top.
4. DeliverExcel workbook, PDF report (generated and downloaded directly) and a self-contained HTML report the team can browse. Archive saves all of them with the source exports in a named folder.

Preview of the report. Click PDF to download the report as a PDF file (A4, named automatically). Title, introduction, date, logo and the number of detailed rows per section are under Settings. Evidence per host is in the HTML report and the Excel workbook; the PDF identifies vulnerabilities by plugin ID.
